artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished original widescreen environment painting for an immersive airport story; a cinematic background, not a website screenshot.
Create a richly inhabited international airport concourse as if it were a carefully art-directed environment shot in the animated FILM Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse. Realistic, sculpted architectural volumes, dimensional cinematic staging, beautifully composed hand-painted surfaces, selective angular shading and tactile dry-brush marks. NOT a game-engine blockout or Roblox scene. This is original artwork, not a copied movie frame.
Composition: 16:9 landscape, preferably about 2400 pixels wide. Eye-height 28mm cinema lens looking forward down a gently bending gate concourse. One very near midnight-indigo structural rib at the far left edge, curved tapering steel roof ribs arching diagonally overhead and receding into a distant vanishing point slightly right of center. Tall sunlit terminal glass fills the right side. Clear walkable center lane and meaningful near/middle/far depth. Foreground airport seating and subtle floor reflections anchor the lower corners. Crop the architecture confidently beyond the image edges: the viewer is INSIDE a large terminal, never looking at a tiny complete building or model.
World details: a single restrained café inset into the left midground with warm wooden joinery, a real stone counter, a few cups, pendant lamps and a small adjacent shawarma grill with a sculpted vertical spit. A few natural travelers and seated passengers, painted with believable anatomy and scale; one small person in a red jersey with white 66 pushing a luggage cart in the middle distance. A tiny background television can show an original warm bear-in-red-hat station vignette, but it must be incidental. Beyond the right glass: airport apron, distant jetway and luminous hazy skyline, all part of the same coherent airport.
Lighting and color: late sunset light entering from the right in amber/coral planes. Deep midnight indigo shadow masses, warm copper and ivory lit edges, cyan bounced light on steel and shadow edges. Rich reflected color, shaped contact shadows, haze between spatial layers, luminous glass. The contrast and hand-painted brushwork should be unmistakably feature-animation cinema. Use selective halftone only within a few soft shadow transitions and a few broken ink contours; never an all-over dot grid or noise overlay.
Text: only a small believable café sign reading "CAFÉ" in the midground; any other wayfinding is tiny abstract airport arrows/icons, not words. No large DXB/KHI/YYZ labels, no giant MATCHA/CHAI signs, no story text.
Constraints: no baked-in personal photographs, no photo-gallery wall, no empty poster-box placeholders, no UI, no borders, no logos, no watermark, no superheroes. Avoid flat magenta walls, toy-box geometry, flat vector illustration, sepia grading, neon synthwave, uniform outlines, shiny plastic and photographic rendering. Preserve a lived-in, richly painted airport feeling. Opaque full-bleed image.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: an original wide airport gate environment painting, the quiet final shot in the same cinematic world as the supplied images.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY style and architectural reference: towering curved glass, monumental navy steel, sunset orange skyline, textured hand-painted dimensional architecture. Input image 2 is the companion concourse painting; match its warm material richness and intimate human scale. Create a new companion viewpoint at the boarding gate, not a copy of either composition.
Scene and composition: 16:9 full-bleed landscape. Eye-height 35mm cinema view from inside an intimate airport gate lounge. A few sculpted dark navy airport seats in the lower left foreground and a strong cropped steel column frame the view. The middle and right open onto floor-to-ceiling curved terminal glazing. Outside, a believable unbranded passenger jet parked at a connected glass-and-metal jetway, seen three-quarter from the nose, with the front fuselage and near wing clearly legible. The aircraft sits mostly in the upper-right/middle-right part of the image, not buried at the bottom. Airport apron markings, a small service vehicle and distant city towers recede into glowing haze. The scene feels like the last few quiet minutes before boarding.
Architecture and space: same tapering curved roof ribs and midnight indigo steel as reference 1. Tangible, realistic scale, deep perspective and sculpted angular color planes. Keep the foreground lower center/right comparatively calm because a boarding-pass interface will be layered there later; DO NOT draw the interface, tickets, panels, poster frames or graphics into the picture. A restrained real gate podium can sit in the left middle distance. Two or three incidental seated passengers may appear small, never as central figures.
Light and medium: high-end animated-film environment painting in the visual language of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse. Hand-painted dry-brush textures, decisive warm/cool shape design, cyan reflected rim light on navy steel, amber sunset spilling over polished stone and seat edges, deep indigo-violet shadows with carefully selective stipple. Sunlit ivory aircraft volumes and coral-orange sky contrast with the cool interior. Strong atmospheric depth; the lighting is cinematic, not a flat filter.
Text: at most one SMALL believable airport sign showing "05"; no other readable lettering, airline logos, film logos, subtitles or watermarks.
Constraints: original environment artwork, never a photographic movie frame. No superheroes, no giant signage, no generic magenta boxes, no primitive/toy/Roblox forms, no flat vector illustration, no sepia wash, no uniform outlines or dots, no neon synthwave. No wall photographs or personal-photo placeholders. Opaque full image, preferably around 2400 pixels wide.
